charaepi_ch0162_90_koki/2301_1101_0100_2:
[Name:PlayerNickname ] was taking a
walk on a mountain when [EN:Gen Ref="255" M="he" F="she" ] spotted
Lucas and Cynthia.
charaepi_ch0162_90_koki/2301_1201_0200_1:
How was that, Cynthia? It felt pretty
solid to me.
charaepi_ch0162_90_koki/2301_1201_0300_1:
Indeed. Your moves have become more
refined.
charaepi_ch0162_90_koki/2301_0401_0500_1:
Oh, [Name:PlayerNickname ]! I asked
Cynthia to help me train!
charaepi_ch0162_90_koki/2301_0302_0600_1: Is this some kind of training?
charaepi_ch0162_90_koki/2301_0402_0700_1:
Oh, [Name:PlayerNickname ]! You’re
right on the money!
charaepi_ch0162_90_koki/2301_1201_0800_1:
I want to know more about Dialga, so I
asked Cynthia for help!
charaepi_ch0162_90_koki/2301_1201_0900_1:
This Dialga once belonged to Cyrus, the boss
of Team Galactic.
charaepi_ch0162_90_koki/2301_1201_1000_1:
But it lent us its strength during our
confrontation with Team Galactic.
charaepi_ch0162_90_koki/2301_1201_1100_1:
It wasn’t until recently that Dialga changed
into a form I’d never known!
charaepi_ch0162_90_koki/2301_1201_1200_1: Dialga’s new form... It’s quite intriguing.
charaepi_ch0162_90_koki/2301_1201_1300_1:
I referred to all sorts of documents,
but information was sparse.
charaepi_ch0162_90_koki/2301_1201_1400_1:
I also asked the people of Hisui, but they
didn’t know much, either.
charaepi_ch0162_90_koki/2301_1201_1500_1:
That’s why I had Dialga show us its strength
directly!
charaepi_ch0162_90_koki/2301_1201_1600_1:
A while back, Cyrus told me to take care
of Dialga.
charaepi_ch0162_90_koki/2301_1201_1700_1:
So, as a sync pair, I’ll bring out Dialga’s
new power and surprise Cyrus!
charaepi_ch0162_90_koki/2301_0401_1900_1: Thanks! I’m even more motivated now!
charaepi_ch0162_90_koki/2301_1201_2300_1: So I need to be a Trainer worthy of Dialga!
charaepi_ch0162_90_koki/2301_1201_2400_1: You have my full support too!
charaepi_ch0162_90_koki/2301_1201_2600_1: I know! While we’re all here...
charaepi_ch0162_90_koki/2301_1201_2700_1:
Let’s have a Pokémon battle! I might learn
something from a strong Trainer like you!
